messages:
Mia (Sales): @Julia thanks for the ask earlier — quick thread to confirm. Acme is requesting access to SOC 2 evidence for a short POC. They asked: can we get a minimal extract (controls + system description) before the POC starts, and do they need to sign an NDA first?
Julia (Acme): ideally we get something today if possible. We can sign an NDA, but want to avoid full report exposure. redactions ok. also curious if a bridge/attestation note would be acceptable to our risk team.
Omar (SE): We usually provide a scoped bundle: system description, control mappings for access mgmt, change mgmt, encryption, and a summary of exceptions. That covers their immediate technical review without giving raw evidence.
Ana (Legal): We can provide a redacted SOC2 extract under our standard NDA. Two options: 1) Signed NDA -> scoped extracts (S3 presigned, redacted) or 2) If they need faster frictionsless routing, we can issue a short bridge-letter/attestation that summarizes scope + period but does not include evidence. Bridge letters still require an acknowledgement.
Mia (Sales): Which one is faster to get approvals for? Acme prefers minimal friction — they'd sign an NDA if that speeds things.
Ana (Legal): NDA turnaround: if they sign our standard mutual NDA, Legal can approve presigned extract within 24 hours. Bridge-letter needs legal + secops signoff and usually takes 48-72 hours because we coordinate with auditors for wording.
Ryan (Eng): From infra: if we share extracts, we'll put them behind a presigned S3 link with download logging + 7d expiry. We can also restrict to a list of IPs if Acme provides them. We should sanitize PII and redact account IDs before upload.
Omar (SE): Suggested control set to include in extract (minimal):
- Logical access (CC6) — user provisioning + MFA screenshots
- Encryption (CC3) — KMS usage and key rotation summary
- Change control (CC5) — release process checklist and a few redacted audit items
This satisfies most vendor risk teams for a POC.
Julia (Acme): IP allowlist is doable. 7 days sounds fine. We prefer the NDA route if it's quick.
Mia (Sales): Action list: 1) Ana to confirm NDA template link + any redaction rules. 2) Ryan to prepare sanitized bundle & presigned link. 3) Omar to assemble control mapping and one-pager. 4) Julia to provide IPs (optional) and sign NDA.
Ana (Legal): I'll drop the NDA doc here and note redaction rules: remove full usernames, internal ticket content, and any raw logs. We keep control artifacts (screenshots, process docs) with minimal redaction.
secops-bot: SOC2 record check: latest Type II period end 2025-11-15. Auditor: NorthPoint LLP.
Ryan (Eng): ETA: I can stage a sanitized bundle by EOD tomorrow after Ana confirms redaction list. I'll create presigned link like:
```
https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-soc2-extracts/acme-1923456789.tar.gz?X-Amz-...
Expires: 7 days
```
Omar (SE): I'll draft the one-pager and control mapping now and attach it to the bundle.
Mia (Sales): Great. Julia can you drop the signed NDA or note if you want bridge-letter instead. If NDA, upload to our legal portal or sign and send back to ana@redwood.com.
Julia (Acme): Sending NDA to Ana now. thanks all.
Ana (Legal): Got it — I'll ack when I receive the signed NDA and then greenlight the upload.
Mia (Sales): Thanks team — will follow up once Ryan posts the link. :thumbsup:
